integrity: The equality layer is regenerated by exhaustive prefix search through length 201 with two independently coded exact suffix-period tests. Both extremizers are then checked by whole-word pseudoperiod and repetition scans; all embedded hashes and the standalone replay are verified.
scientific_limitations: The scalar maximum length 200 and optimal critical-exponent entry are prior work. The new claim is only the complete length-200 equality layer: exactly two complementary palindromes. Near-extremal words and other pseudoperiod pairs are not classified. Unpublished source-author search logs could contain the same top layer.
title: Two palindromic extremizers for pseudoperiod \((9,12)\) at the \(\frac{55}{21}\)-free boundary
